name: Wodewose
body:
Known by different names on different planes, wodewoses are a group of looselyrelated humanoid species with animalistic features. Originally hailing from several different Outer Planes, some can also be found in the Fey Realms and even secluded areas of wilderness in the Material Plane.

Appearance

Wodewoses vary widely in their appearance, but most are just slightly shorter and leaner than humans. They are covered by a fine layer of fur, which usually mimics animals of the wild but can also be green, violet, blue, silver, or any other color. The hair on their heads is usually like a human’s, but may be striped or spotted, reminiscent of an animal’s pelt. Their eyes are catlike, and their ears and teeth are slightly pointed, reminiscent of a canine or other wild animal.

Social

Just as their appearance will remind many of a wild animal, a wodewose’s personality takes many cues from the beasts of the wild.

They are known to wear their emotions on their sleevedicequick to laugh and quick to anger. Though considered savage by many, they can be playful and lighthearted, especially among family and friends, and the bonds they form run deep.

Wodewoses are wild at heart. They are most comfortable around animals and fey, and are uncomfortable around most humanoids.

They are especially uncomfortable in cities, and may feel a sense of oppressive dread surrounded by crowds and walls instead of trees and fields.

Alignment and Religion

A wodewose cherishes nothing so much as their freedomdicebut most also feel a strong sense of injustice when the freedom of their allies, associates, and even innocent strangers is encroached upon. This strong call for liberty above all steers most wodewoses towards the Chaotic Good alignment.

Many wodewoses pay homage to a deity of nature, freedom, beasts, or battledicenot necessarily in the form of actual worship but more as a show of respect. Wodewoses rarely become clerics, but some are happy as druids or shifters.

Names

Some typical wodewose names include the following (choose or roll 1d12): 1 Borgakar, 2 Dyruleiki, 3 Fjottlyn, 4 Frelsi, 5 Heidilga, 6 Hradingar, 7 Leisylka, 8 Otti, 9 Raltur, 10 Skogangar, 11 Tilbend, 12 Viltor

Common Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You have the instincts, reflexes, and all the charm of an apex predator. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Cha [specialized]. (1)
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. (0)
Type You are a Humanoid with the wodewose subtype. You also gain the extraplanar subtype when on any plane other than a transitive plane or your own native plane. (0)
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Celestial. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Sylvan. (0)
Other Traits
Burst of Ferocity Once per day, when you are reduced to fewer than 0 hit points but not killed, you can fight on for 1 more round as if disabled. At the end of your next turn, unless brought to above 0 hit points, you immediately fall unconscious and begin to die. (2)
Claws You have two claw attacks. These are primary natural weapons that deal 1d4 damage each. (2)
Darkvision You have darkvision 60 feet. (2)
Jumper You are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump. (2)
Scent You have the scent universal monster ability. (4)
Total: 13 RP (advanced)
Alternate Traits
Brute You were born to break your rusty cage and run. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Str, +2 Wis, -2 Int. This trait alters ability score modifiers.
Burrow You have thick, strong limbs built for digging. Your base speed is only 20 feet, but it is never modified for armor or encumbrance. In addition, you have a burrow speed of 10 feet. This trait requires the claws trait; it alters speed and replaces jumper.
Deft Claw If you make a successful claw attack against an opponent, you gain a +2 species bonus on your next attack against the same opponent if that attack is a combat maneuver attempt made to disarm, steal, or trip. This trait requires the claws trait and replaces jumper.
Durable You are burly and tough, but your reflexes are slower than those of your kin. You gain a +2 species bonus to saving throws against poison and disease, and your ability score modifiers are +4 Con, -2 Dex, and -2 Cha. This trait alters ability score modifiers and replaces jumper.
Natural Cunning You gain a +2 species bonus to Bluff and Stealth checks. This trait replaces scent.
Poisonous Claws A number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), you can envenom your claws as a swift action. This trait replaces burst of ferocity. Wodewose Venom: Injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Int; cure 1 save.
Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Add +1 to your total number of rage rounds per day.
Druid Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks relating to animals.
Fighter Add a +2 bonus on rolls to stabilize when dying.
Monk Add +1/2 to your damage rolls with claw attacks. If you select this bonus, you also treat your claw natural attacks as a monk weapon. If you are an unchained monk, you can use your style strikes with unarmed strike or claw attacks.
Paladin Add +1/3 bonus critical hit confirmation rolls made while using smite evil (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Ranger Add +1/4 to your favored terrain for any Plane terrain. You must have selected favored terrain (Plane) to select this option.
Rogue Add +1/2 to sneak attack damage dealt to creatures with the outsider type.
Shifter Add a +1/3 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls when using shifter claws (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Slayer Increase the studied target bonus on Perception and Survival checks by +1/4. When you gain the stalker class feature, you also gain this increase to your studied target bonus on Stealth checks.
Spirit Warrior Add +1/5 to your aura bonus when using the senses aura or speed aura.

Awesome Ancestries: Fantasy Animal Humanoids, Vol. 3 - Born to Be Wild. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
